title: Maqbool Hussain v. State of Bombay

content.caseIdentity: Maqbool Hussain v. State of Bombay, 1953 SCR 730
content.holding: Confiscation of gold by Sea Customs authorities is an administrative penalty, not a criminal conviction by a court; subsequent criminal trial does not violate Article 20(2).
content.relevance: Established that Article 20(2) requires judicial prosecution and punishment.
